## New features
- Vertical area sources for windows, louvres and other emitting facade panels. Set bottom and top heights before drawing, hold Shift to snap to a building facade, and edit each node's AGL or absolute heights in the inspector.
- Building radiation inputs: indoor sound level, single-value or spectral transmission loss, and a selectable room diffusivity correction. AURIS displays the resulting sound power and sound power per square metre.
- Shared building indoor levels for assigned facade panels, with per-panel transmission losses and overrides. Selected panels can be edited together without replacing their other inputs.
- A report input appendix from the Inputs workspace: export an A4-width Excel workbook or copy a formatted table, grouped by general settings, periods, sources, buildings, screening, receptors and terrain.
- Parking lots with emissions derived from the Bavarian LfU parking study (2007). Set parking type, reference quantity, movement rates and surface, with combined or separated circulation procedures and an explicit impulsivity correction.
- Source directivity controls for point, line and horizontal or vertical area sources, including generic vent and loudspeaker presets, orientation, and outward radiation from attached surfaces.
- Plan and vertical Section views in Contour Composer. Draw up to four named sections; each retains its own cameras, sheet area, lock state and saved runs. Section calculations use actual vertical receivers and intersected terrain, buildings, barriers and sources.

## Changes
- The AURIS expansion is now Acoustic Utility for Receptor Impact Studies.
- Live Preview starts with a bounded coarse pass and progressively adds accurate production-solver samples. Model edits cancel outdated work and refresh the preview.
- The Composer View selector sits beside the viewport controls. Animated eyes independently show or hide section lines on sheets and exports; lines remain available for editing.
- Section labels follow their line with a gap beneath the text. A compact S icon identifies the section drawing tool.
- Vertical panes use two-click drawing, a facade snap preview and continued wall snapping after the first attached point. Attached panes slide along the wall; hold Shift to move them away or snap to another facade.
- Section presentation includes authored carriageways and reservations, rail tracks, berms and crest barriers. Building fills, brick patterns, names and height markers follow the plan presentation.
- Section sheets show coordinate and elevation labels when the neatline is enabled, without a second set of viewport axis ticks.
- The 3D workspace uses the shared A/B basemap selector and defaults to plan building fill colours, including brick patterns.
- Dropdowns place the current value in a muted header above the alternatives. Selectors with a single option stay closed and omit their arrow.
- Consultant qualifications accompany the name in project selectors and sheet outputs, using smaller lettering on the same baseline.
- Parking uses a lighter blue sign and outline, with a selectable 50% translucent fill so the basemap remains visible beneath it.
- Barriers use violet; terrain height points and the ruler use amber. Rotation handles appear during double-click editing with a dashed stem to the centre handle.
- Terrain import has bounded retries, validated batching, a reusable cache and a separate optional Elevation API key. Progress and partial failures are clearer.

## Bug fixes
- Roads on undulating terrain could intersect the visible terrain surface.
- Unlocked Sheet Preview could use a different crop from the Editor's sheet area.
- Section contours could leave a narrow unpainted strip above the physical ground.
- Cancelled presentation workers could outlive a deleted Composer or be destroyed on the wrong thread.
- Vertical source inspector fields could overlap. Emission choices and incomplete transmission entries now persist across selection changes without silently using previous values.
- Mouse-wheel gestures over inputs now scroll the surrounding interface without changing values, including focused numeric controls and dropdowns.
- macOS user-requested calculations now hold a scoped activity to keep their timers and progress responsive in the background, releasing it on completion or cancellation while still allowing normal idle sleep.
